label: estimate
description: Assumptions behind every [estimate] cost figure in the README, landing page and Savings panel. Figures are per 1,000 answers. Change an input or a price and validate.mjs recomputes every figure; the stated per_1k_usd must stay within tolerance, so copy and arithmetic cannot drift apart.

fast_check_input_tokens.basis: Typical fast-check request with the default question set: about 275 overhead + about 600 for 4 questions + prompt, answer and evidence (4-6k typical; 24k worst case).

same_checks_input_tokens.basis: The same state and questions sent to an LLM judge.

same_checks_output_tokens.basis: A short structured answer for 4 questions.

claims_per_answer.basis: Claims decomposed from a typical support or RAG answer.

decompose_input_tokens.basis: Decomposer prompt plus the question and answer.

evidence_context_tokens.basis: Evidence sent with each claim verification.

claim_tokens.basis: The claim and the user question framing it.

verify_output_tokens.basis: Verdict, confidence, reasoning and quote per claim.

grounding_flag_rate.basis: Assumed share of answers with a grounding trigger (deep audit lane high).

token_model.formula: llm_same_checks = sum over gated answers of (jev_input_tokens + 400) x judge input price + 40 x questions x judge output price

figures.title: Fast check on every answer
figures.formula: 5,000 input tokens x $0.042/M (output free) = $0.00021 per answer

figures.title: The same checks asked of Claude Haiku
figures.formula: 5,000 input tokens x $1/M + 150 output tokens x $5/M = $0.00575 per answer

figures.title: Full claim-level LLM audit of every answer
figures.formula: decompose (1,000 in + 300 out) + 8 claims x ((3,000 evidence + 450 prompt + 75 claim) in + 120 out), Haiku $1/$5 per M = $0.0025 + $0.033 = $0.0355 per answer

figures.title: Total with shipped defaults
figures.formula: fast check on all + full audit x (5% grounding-flagged + 2% of the other 95% + 1% uniform) = $0.21 + 0.079 x $35.5 = $3.01
